page.layout: One column of running text on one printed page. Running head across the top, page number at top left. No marginal notes and no footnotes. Nothing below the text except the catchword at the right.

main_text.l: Ut cedat optimè universis, nulla melius ac-
[?]tione efficietur, quam si æquo, honesto & gra-
vi more Omnes simul consilia in commune
conferant, publico omnia consensu agantur
sine Tumultu & Tyrannide, non enim ideo nos
fame necare oportet, quia salubres cibi non-
nullis in naufeam & morbum vertuntur.
Sin eò res devenerit, ut in Jura nostra Re-
gia nunquam amplius restituamur, & id scilicet
vera Dei Justitia poscente perstituri [?] sint usque
Subditi Mei in peccatis suis, & prospero sce-
lere deludendi: Spero Gratiam Divinam id in
Te & Me effecturam, ut simus æque carendo
Diademati ac gestando pares; quod profecto
tanti non est ut inhonestis, sordidis, & impiis
conditionibus aut servari mereatur, aut ab
humo sustolli. Firmus Pietati & Virtuti ma-
neas, nunquam Regnum deerit.
In hoc vero potissimum Honori tuo consu-
les, quo omne promptius reverentiam & amo-
rem detuleris, & in præsidium porro te stite-
ris Uxori Meæ, Matri Tuæ, de Me plurimis
nominibus optime meritæ, & in his præci-
pue, quæ (cum Me tot prius liberis summæ
spei auxisset, quos omnes unà cum Matre
Amori Tuo & fidei commendo) raro magnan-
imitatis & Patientiæ exemplo pro Me & Te
simul & nobiscum unà perpessa est.
Deum Omnipotentem veneror quicquid
de Me facturus est, qui Innocentiâ Meâ & il-
lius Gratiâ involvor satis & munior, ut te
An-choram protollat vel potius Calami-

page.notes: The first line of the second paragraph and the page break in the first paragraph ("ac-[?]tione") are doubtful: the line-end hyphen is hard to make out. "perstituri" is hard to read, so I marked it [?]. The running head is set in Greek capitals (ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ); the last letter reads as H and the Ω may be a Latin-looking letter in print. The long s is transcribed as plain s throughout, and the printed u/v and i/j forms are normalised. The small dots and marks beside "publico" and "quia" and the mark at the right edge are typesetting marks, not text, so I left them out.
